name: Williden's Journal
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.
narrative.objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well look at this - my journal!  I thought it was lost, much like almost everything else we brought into Un'Goro.  I thank you kindly for returning this to me!
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello there!  I and my companions are happy to see some living beings here other than overgrown savage beasts!  What brings you into the Un'Goro Crater?
